requirements.title: ABS arguments are integer, real, or complex
requirements.definition: The actual argument A to ABS shall be of type integer, real, or complex.

pending.abs-argument-integer-real-or-complex: Future positive controls call ABS with integer, real, and complex arguments; invalid source controls use one nonnumeric argument shape but expect no local diagnostic because this is an unnumbered argument restriction.

requirements.title: ABS result characteristics follow the argument with complex magnitude real
requirements.definition: The ABS result has the same characteristics as A except that a complex A produces a real result.

pending.abs-integer-result-characteristics: Future exact fixture calls ABS on a nondefault negative integer of a selected kind and asserts KIND(ABS(A)) equals KIND(A).
pending.abs-real-result-characteristics: Future fixture calls ABS on a negative exactly representable real value and asserts the result kind matches A while avoiding rounded-value claims beyond exact sign removal.
pending.abs-complex-result-real-characteristics: Future fixture calls ABS on a complex argument and uses type/kind-compatible assignment or KIND comparison to prove the result is real of the corresponding real kind, without asserting an exact magnitude for nontrivial complex inputs.

requirements.title: ABS returns exact absolute value for integer and real arguments
requirements.source: 16.9.2 p5 first clause; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF376.
requirements.definition: If A is of type integer or real, the value of the ABS result is the absolute value of A.

pending.abs-integer-negative-to-positive: Future exact fixture initializes an integer to a nonzero negative sentinel such as -7 and asserts ABS gives 7; mutation swaps SIGN or unary identity.
pending.abs-integer-nonnegative-unchanged: Future exact fixture checks ABS of a distinct positive integer remains unchanged and is not satisfied by a default zero value.
pending.abs-real-exact-sign-removal: Future fixture uses exactly representable real values such as -2.0 and 3.0 and asserts exact sign removal or unchanged positive value, avoiding overflow and rounding-sensitive magnitudes.

requirements.title: ABS complex magnitude approximation is processor dependent
requirements.source: 16.9.2 p5 complex approximation; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF376.
requirements.definition: For complex A with value (x,y), ABS returns a processor-dependent approximation to sqrt(x**2+y**2).

pending.abs-complex-magnitude-processor-dependen: No portable oracle may require a particular rounded complex magnitude. Future tests may use only broad properties independently fixed by other text, or examples as approximate smoke controls that do not claim exact conformance.

requirements.title: ABS complex magnitude is computed without undue overflow or underflow
requirements.source: 16.9.2 p5 final phrase; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF376.
requirements.definition: For complex A, the processor-dependent magnitude approximation is computed without undue overflow or underflow.

pending.abs-complex-magnitude-avoids-undue-overf: No portable oracle is registered in this source packet because the standard gives no numeric bound for 'undue' and the approximation itself is processor dependent; future IEEE/profile-specific tests must first establish kind support and a source-derived safe range.
